contract_plain_english: In the inherited one-dimensional constant-coefficient acoustic system, pressure p and particle velocity u satisfy p_t + K u_x = 0 and u_t + (1/ρ)p_x = 0, with constant bulk modulus K and density ρ. With sound speed c = √(K/ρ), the combination w² = p − ρcu satisfies w²_t − c w²_x = 0. This is a one-way wave equation with signed propagation speed −c, modeling acoustic propagation to the left at sound speed c. The source also states that this equation has solutions of the printed form q²(x,t) = q̃(x + ct), switching notation from w² to q² without explanation. These claims occur on raw PDF page 24, printed page 2, in equation (1.5), the definition of c, and the final mode discussion; the real-variable and derivative conventions are supplied on raw PDF page 23 after equation (1.1). Precise regularity and a complete list of admissible material-parameter assumptions are not stated.
